description: Synthesize definitions, caller/callee references, related tests, and architectural notes for a specific code symbol in a namespace (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { results, total_candidates } (up to 20 ranked matches). Pass a non-empty identifier via target or its equivalent alias symbol (throws if both are omitted). Use before editing a known function, class, or module to check its blast radius and invariants; use search_code instead when you only have keywords and need to find symbol names first.

depth.description: Optional traversal depth hint (shallow, standard, or deep).

namespace.description: Logical repository or workspace namespace (defaults to MEMORIA_NAMESPACE or "default").

symbol.description: Equivalent alias for target identifier (provide target or symbol).

target.description: Exact function, class, or module identifier to explain (provide target or symbol).

name: explain_code

results.description: Ranked { memory, score } symbol definitions, callers, and architectural rules (max 20).

title: Explain Code Symbol
